name: Howsit
author: howsitai

sections.description:
The Howsit WordPress plugin allows you to add an AI-powered Agent to your WordPress website without needing coding knowledge. It helps automate customer interactions, book appointments, and provide automated customer support and help capture leads.

Language Support

The agent supports multiple languages including:

  • English
  • French / Français
  • Spanish / Español
  • Italian / Italiano
  • German / Deutsch
  • Swedish / Svenska
  • Portuguese / Português
  • Hindi / हिन्दी
  • Japanese / 日本語
  • Russian / Русский
  • Persian / فارسی
  • Dutch / Nederlands
  • Arabic / العربية
  • Turkish / Türkçe
  • Hebrew / עברית
  • Croatian / Hrvatski
  • Albanian / Shqiptare
  • Chinese / 中国人
  • Indonesian / Bahasa Indonesia
  • Hungarian / Magyar
  • Welsh / Cymraeg
  • Chinese (Traditional) / 繁體中文
  • Polish / Polski
  • Thai / ไทย
  • Vietnamese / Tiếng Việt
  • Ukrainian / Українська
  • Romanian / Română
  • Venda / Tshivenḓa
  • Sotho / Sesotho
  • Xhosa / Isixhosa
  • Zulu / Isizulu

External services

This plugin relies on an external service to provide the chatbot interface and functionality. This service is offered via Content Delivery Network (CDN) at cdn.express-chat.com. By using this plugin, you enable the chatbot functionality on your website, which loads a JavaScript file (website-bot.js) from this CDN.

Details of the external service:

  • Purpose: To load and display the agent interface, and handle user interactions within the chat.
  • Data Sent: When users interact with the agent, data related to their chat session, such as messages and possibly their IP address, may be sent.
sections.installation:
Follow these steps to install and configure the plugin:

  1. Install and activate the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Go to the plugin settings page.

To get your unique key:

  1. Go to the Howsit Dashboard: https://platform.howsit.ai/
  2. Create a Website Bot or an Agent.
  3. Click “Install Your Chatbot” or “Install Agent”.
  4. Select WordPress.

  5. Copy the generated unique key.

  6. Paste the key into the plugin settings.

  7. Save changes.

The agent will now be active on your website.

From WordPress Admin

  • Go to Plugins → Add New
  • Search for “Howsit”
  • Click Install Now and then Activate

Using FTP

  • Upload the Howsit folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  • Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu
sections.faq:
Here are some frequently asked questions:

What is Howsit?

Howsit is a WordPress plugin that allows you to integrate an AI-powered Agent directly onto your website. It helps you automate customer support, engage visitors, and capture leads 24/7 without any coding required.

Can you use ChatGPT with WordPress?

Yes. Howsit’s ChatGPT-integrated agent is designed for WordPress, allowing you to enhance user engagement and automate interactions on your website 24/7. You can integrate the ChatGPT model of your choice and train the GPT agent on your data to fit your specific use case.

Is Howsit difficult to set up?

Not at all. The setup process is designed to be user-friendly. After activating the plugin, you will be guided through a simple configuration process to connect your Howsit account and get the agent running on your site in minutes.

How do I see the conversations and leads collected by the agent?

All conversations and data collected by the agent are stored in your Howsit dashboard. You can log in to your account to view chat history, access lead information, and analyze the agent’s performance.

What are some of the things I can do with Howsit agent?

You can use the agent for a vast range of tasks, including:

  • Customer Support & Answering FAQs
  • Lead Generation (Email, Newsletters)
  • Appointment Setting & Scheduling
  • Managing To-do Lists and Reminders
  • Conducting Surveys

And many more business functions.

Are there any ready-to-use templates available?

Yes, Howsit comes with a wide variety of pre-built templates for numerous industries to help you get started quickly. These include templates for:

  • Real Estate & Legal Services
  • Travel, Hotel & Restaurant Booking
  • Healthcare (Dental Clinics, Doctor Appointments)
  • E-commerce & Product Catalogs
  • Education (Universities, Coaching)
  • Digital Marketing & HR Consultancies
    And many more……

Does Howsit integrate with WhatsApp?

While it is not a dedicated WhatsApp plugin, Howsit seamlessly integrates with WhatsApp. This allows you to create a comprehensive WhatsApp agent experience, including marketing automation, drip & broadcast campaigns, notifications, and bookings.

In what languages can the agent communicate?

Howsit supports multiple languages. You can configure the agent to interact with your website visitors in the language of your choice to provide a more personalized experience.

Can I take over a conversation from the agent?

Yes, most configurations allow for a “live chat” takeover feature. If a visitor needs to speak with a human agent, the agent can notify you, and you can jump into the conversation directly from your Howsit dashboard.
